agent_explanation: Single ball dropped from y=1.9 with vy~-17.7 hits floor between steps 90-91. Incoming speed ~18.34 m/s with e=0.5 should rebound at ~9.2 m/s, but it rebounds at ~28.96 m/s and total energy jumps 176->427 J with zero controller work. The e=0 test still gains energy (176->203 J), so it is not restitution gain but floor contact resolution adding energy on a fast impact: deep penetration per substep corrected positionally plus an over-large impulse, injecting both potential and kinetic energy.
